class.name: LocalizedTexture2D
class.brief_description: A texture with a different texture per locale.
class.description: A texture showing a different texture for each locale, such as images with text. It can be used wherever a [Texture2D] is, and the nodes using it update when the locale changes. The resource of the locale is chosen like translations: the one of the current locale, or else of its language (for example [code]pt[/code] for [code]pt_BR[/code]), or else of the [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/fallback] locale, or else the default one. In the editor, the preview locale is used, or else the fallback locale. It changes when [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed] is emitted. The texture of the locale is drawn by that texture, so [AtlasTexture]s draw their region. [method Resource.get_rid] returns the same proxy texture for all locales, so materials and shaders show the texture of the new locale too.

method.name: get_current_texture
method.description: Returns the texture used for the current locale.

members.member: The texture used when no texture of [member textures] matches the locale.
The texture of each locale, the keys being locale codes such as [code]en[/code] or [code]pt_BR[/code].
